issues.description: The experimental R entry reads rawData/nonGAAPSPSS.sav, absent from the supplied inventory. The datasheet documents an author request route, but no input was acquired or checked for the complete field/period contract.

SurveyCode.R requests Qualtrics survey SV_e8pXNaxn0ZCL0Vv using a private key intentionally hidden in the package. No response data or authorized API route was verified; no credential inspection or request was performed.

ExperimentCode.R calls describeBy but loads tidyverse, broom, haven and knitr without importing psych. psych is absent from the local package inventory; a working-copy import and package setup are required for this call.

Five custom NONGAAP input members are named but not supplied with schemas or member lineage. The program sorts NONGAAP2 and CSTAT by TIC/FYEARQ/FQTR but then merges by TIC/DATAFQTR; source ownership, types, intended key and compatible sort order are unresolved, so no replacement key is inferred.

Two distinct local IBES candidate families have required named fields, but the author-created NONGAAP.IBESDATA family and transformation are unspecified. EPSUS and XEPSUS are retained as distinct candidates, not treated as interchangeable alternatives.

STDEV is included in the archival winsor call but is not created by the supplied code. The bounded IBES candidates expose an STDEV field, but the intended family and custom-member source mapping remain unverified.

In the embedded no-byvar branch, the DATA step creates BYVAR while subsequent macro logic sorts and merges by XBYVAR and drops XBYVAR. In an extracted working copy, change the assignment to xbyvar = 1; so the created key matches the downstream name.

The provided SAS probe failed at TKELS initialization. This does not establish license absence or component availability; a bounded authorized environment check remains to be done before any author workflow execution.

evidence.description: The experimental participant reconciliation consumes self-reported accounting knowledge and screening-answer fields.
evidence.quote:
SelfReportNoAcctKnowPs <- FinishedPs %>% 
  filter(Q68 == 1 |
           Q68 == 2 |
           Q69 == 2 )

SelfReportAcctKnowPs <- FinishedPs %>%filter((Q68 == 3 | Q68 == 4 | Q68 == 5) & (Q69 == 1 ))

#Screening Questions
AcctQIncorrectPs <- SelfReportAcctKnowPs %>% filter(AcctKnow1 != 4 | AcctKnow2 != 2)
AcctQCorrectPs <- SelfReportAcctKnowPs %>% filter(AcctKnow1 == 4 & AcctKnow2 == 2)

evidence.description: The experiment branch uses completion, attention, prompt and speeder fields for its sample reconciliation.
evidence.quote:
FocusCompQPassPs <- AcctQCorrectPs %>% filter((Comp2 == 2 & Comp1 == 3 & Income == "Net Income") | (Comp2 == 2 & Comp1 == 4 & Income == "Adjusted"))
FocusCompQFailPs <- AcctQCorrectPs %>% filter(Comp2 != 2 | (Income == "Net Income" & Comp1 != 3) | (Income == "Adjusted" & Comp1 != 4))

PromptCompQPassPs <- FocusCompQPassPs %>% filter(term != "PromptCompFail")
PromptCompQFailPs <- FocusCompQPassPs %>% filter(term == "PromptCompFail")

#Speeders
speederPs <- PromptCompQPassPs %>% filter(term == "speeder")
finalsamplePs <- PromptCompQPassPs %>% filter(term != "speeder")
